payload.title: Site deletion checks only farm-service's own tables: the delete preview and the delete command ignore sensors, HR units and user site assignments that other services hold against the site, so a site with live sensors or assigned users is deleted and leaves dangling references
evidence: apps/farm-service/src/site/handlers/get-site-delete-preview.handler.ts:47-89 (the preview counts only farm-schema departments, systems, tanks and equipment)
apps/farm-service/src/site/handlers/delete-site.handler.ts:61-66 (a non-cascade delete is blocked only by farm departments)
apps/farm-service/src/site/handlers/delete-site.handler.ts:167-172 (the site is soft-deleted without asking sensor, hr or auth)
apps/sensor-service/src/database/entities/sensor.entity.ts:236 (sensors hold a farm site id that survives the delete)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/authentication/entities/user-site-assignment.entity.ts:38-41 (user site assignments hold farm site ids, deliberately without an FK)
apps/gateway-api/src/websocket/farm-nats-bridge.service.ts:399-400 (the only SiteDeleted consumer is a socket broadcast; no owning service reacts)
payload.rule_violated: Plan PKG-21 requires that deleting a site show and respect references held by other services. The registry owner must not orphan cross-service references it cannot see (ADR 052).
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-21, release R9.
